user_prompt:
Academic literature search and screening flowchart for systematic review of TCM blood component analysis. Professional clean design, blue and gray color scheme, Chinese and English bilingual labels.

FLOWCHART STRUCTURE (top to bottom):

BOX 1 (top, wide, blue): 'Literature Database Search / 数据库检索'
Four sub-boxes below showing databases searched in parallel:
- CNKI (中国知网): n=XXX
- Wanfang Data (万方数据): n=XXX  
- PubMed: n=XXX
- Web of Science: n=XXX
Time period shown: 2016-2026

MERGE ARROW DOWN to:
BOX 2 (gray): 'Initial Records Retrieved / 初步检索结果合并去重'
Total records identified after deduplication: n=XXXX

ARROW DOWN with FILTER:
EXCLUSION BOX (right side, orange): 'Records Excluded / 排除文献'
Reasons listed:
- Non-rat in vivo studies (excluded in vitro only)
- Non-oral administration route (IV/IM excluded)
- Non-target herbs
- Language restrictions

BOX 3: 'Title and Abstract Screening / 标题摘要筛选'
Records screened: n=XXX

ARROW DOWN with another FILTER:
EXCLUSION BOX 2 (right, orange): 'Excluded after abstract review'
- No pharmacokinetic data
- Duplicate studies
- Non-blood component analysis

BOX 4: 'Full-text Eligibility Assessment / 全文评估'
Full texts assessed: n=XX

ARROW DOWN with final FILTER:
EXCLUSION BOX 3 (right, orange): 'Excluded after full-text review'
- Insufficient methodology
- No rat plasma data

FINAL BOX (bottom, green, prominent): 'Studies Included in Analysis / 纳入文献'
Final included: n=XX
- General methodology papers: n=X
- Per-herb specific studies: n=XX

CAPTION: Search period: 2016-2026; Keywords: UPLC-MS, pharmacokinetics, blood components, serum pharmacochemistry
Style: Clean PRISMA-style flowchart, professional academic look, clear arrows, appropriate spacing, bilingual labels

iterations.prompt:
Create a high-quality scientific diagram with these requirements:

VISUAL QUALITY:
- Clean white or light background (no textures or gradients)
- High contrast for readability and printing
- Professional, publication-ready appearance
- Sharp, clear lines and text
- Adequate spacing between elements to prevent crowding

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Clear, readable sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica style)
- Minimum 10pt font size for all labels
- Consistent font sizes throughout
- All text horizontal or clearly readable
- No overlapping text

SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS:
- Accurate representation of concepts
- Clear labels for all components
- Include scale bars, legends, or axes where appropriate
- Use standard scientific notation and symbols
- Include units where applicable

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Colorblind-friendly color palette (use Okabe-Ito colors if using color)
- High contrast between elements
- Redundant encoding (shapes + colors, not just colors)
- Works well in grayscale

LAYOUT:
- Logical flow (left-to-right or top-to-bottom)
- Clear visual hierarchy
- Balanced composition
- Appropriate use of whitespace
- No clutter or unnecessary decorative elements

IMPORTANT - NO FIGURE NUMBERS:
- Do NOT include "Figure 1:", "Fig. 1", or any figure numbering in the image
- Do NOT add captions or titles like "Figure: ..." at the top or bottom
- Figure numbers and captions are added separately in the document/LaTeX
- The diagram should contain only the visual content itself
